runner_contract.source: Create a local no-hardlinks detached checkout from the retained Git object database at the exact inherited revision; never fetch or read dirty worktree files.
runner_contract.cleanliness_gate: Require exact HEAD and tree identity plus an empty git status before adding declared external fixtures or running bootstrap.
runner_contract.container_git_gate: Add only /data/project to Git safe.directory for the temporary bind mount.
runner_contract.mount: Mount the temporary checkout at /data/project and EnvSolve policy code read-only.
runner_contract.external_fixture: Create only preregistered safe single-component directories after the clean-checkout gate and fail on repository-path collision.
runner_contract.bootstrap: Source the exact inherited frozen bootstrap in one persistent shell without creating benchmark result artifacts.
runner_contract.network_transition: Allow network only during bootstrap; disconnect every Docker network before V1 evidence collection and resolver execution.
runner_contract.project_distribution: Use only frozen PEP 610 or legacy egg-link plus uniquely matched project-owned metadata provenance.
runner_contract.v1_collection: Read exact Requires-Dist from content-addressed installed project metadata; record installed name/version observations and the container marker environment; pass only preregistered extras; execute direct python -m pip check from an empty directory.
runner_contract.aggregation: Any attributable project-closure failure fails V1; incomplete collection or an unattributable nonzero ambient resolver makes V1 unknown; only complete consistent evidence may pass.
runner_contract.temporary_storage: Use the host platform temporary directory unless an explicit bind-mount-safe root is supplied.
runner_contract.cleanup: Always remove the container and temporary checkout.

expected_causal_checks.bootstrap_non_regression: Round 11 established 5/5 bootstrap Pass; any new bootstrap failure is an environment or runner regression and does not produce V1 evidence.
expected_causal_checks.extras: Observed selected extras must exactly match the list keyed by each frozen bootstrap SHA256.
expected_causal_checks.resolver: Every resolver check must use the active container Python, direct argv, an empty working directory, and host-confirmed network isolation.
expected_causal_checks.project_attribution: A project-closure issue may fail V1 independently of pip check; a nonzero bare pip check cannot fail an otherwise consistent project closure.
expected_causal_checks.unknown: Missing provenance, incomplete installed-state collection, invalid resolver evidence, or ambient-only resolver failure remains unknown.
expected_causal_checks.official_outcomes: No official verifier runs and no official score changes.
